description: Change a routing policy. Only the fields you send change; config replaces the whole config. The strategy must still be usable with the config that results. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

config.description: What the strategy needs. weights gives each function id a share (weighted). rules each send requests whose field matches to a function (policy). fallback_chain lists function ids to try in order when the strategy picks none.

circuit_breaker.description: When to stop sending to a failing function.

failure_threshold.description: Failures in a row before it opens.

half_open_max_calls.description: Trial calls while it tries again.

fallback_chain.description: Function ids to try in order.

max_cost_per_unit.description: The most one unit may cost, in USD.

max_latency_ms.description: The slowest answer, in milliseconds, a function may take.

rules.description: Checked in order; the first match picks the function.

function_id.description: The function to use on a match.

value.description: What to compare against; a list for in.

weights.description: A share per function id, never negative; weighted needs at least one above zero.

fallback_function_id.description: A function to use when the strategy picks none. Null clears it.

policy_id.description: The routing policy UUID: id on a list_routing_policies result.

name: update_routing_policy
